title: The Use and Misuse of Average and Marginal Energy Prices: Implications for Climate Policy
title_zh: 平均与边际能源价格的使用与误用：对气候政策的启示
authors: Jonathan T. Hawkins-Pierot, Katherine R.H. Wagner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many governments and institutions use marginal price signals, such as fuel and carbon taxes, to meet emission reduction targets. However, the responses of firms and individuals to these price signals are often calculated using average prices commonly reported in economic data, rather than marginal prices. This paper first documents that the marginal price of electricity paid by U.S. manufacturing plants is 50% lower than the average price. To do so, we construct a novel dataset of both average and marginal electricity prices, and the wedge between these, using plant-level microdata from the U.S. Census and utility-level electricity rate schedules for over two hundred utilities. Second, we provide guidance on when average prices are an appropriate proxy for marginal prices in price elasticities by identifying economic and geographic characteristics that predict variation in this wedge. Overall, the magnitude of this wedge suggests that the standard use of average energy prices to calculate responses to carbon taxes may underestimate the energy price increases needed to meet emissions targets by 50%.
abstract_zh: 许多政府与机构采用边际价格信号（如燃油税与碳税）以实现减排目标。然而，企业与个人对这些价格信号的响应，通常基于经济数据中普遍报告的平均价格而非边际价格进行计算。本文首先发现，美国制造业工厂支付的电价边际价格比平均价格低50%。为此，我们利用美国人口普查局的工厂级微观数据及覆盖两百多家公用事业公司的电价费率表，构建了包含平均电价、边际电价及其差额的新型数据集。其次，通过识别预测该差额变化的经济与地理特征，本文为平均价格在何种情况下可作为边际价格弹性分析的合理代理变量提供了指导。总体而言，这一差额的规模表明：若以标准方式使用平均能源价格计算碳税响应，可能使实现排放目标所需的能源价格涨幅被低估50%。

title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角
authors: Dirk Bergemann, Tibor Heumann, Michael Wang, Dirk Bergemann; Tibor Heumann; Michael Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。
